HOW IT WORKS
1
Get a Quote or Lock in a Price
Select the products you want to sell from the listing above. If you don't see your product, email or call us. When ready, checkout to lock in your price.
2
Ship Your Products to Us
Once you've locked in your sale, you'll receive an email with mailing instructions. Please follow them exactly to ensure safe arrival of your products.
3
Receive Payment
Once we receive your package, our inventory team will inspect each item and approve the sale. After approval, your payment will be issued.
WHY SELL TO BULLION TRADING LLC?
🏆
Trusted Leader
We purchase tens of millions in product from our customers each month.
💰
Transparent Pricing
Our buyback prices are clearly published and continually updated based on current market conditions.
📦
Easy Shipping
We provide UPS shipping labels. Drop off at a UPS facility, schedule a pickup, or ship on your own.
⚡
Fast Payment
Receive payment in 1–3 business days after products are authenticated.
